findings.source: Fanatic: Я его видел СОБСТВЕННЫМИ ГЛАЗАМИ!!!
findings.currentTarget: Fanatic: NILIMWONA KWA MACHO YANGU MWENYEWE!!!
findings.proposedFullTarget: Fanatic: NILIIONA KWA MACHO YANGU MWENYEWE!!!
findings.objectiveReason: The antecedent is beer, bia, explicitly named in the preceding unit and consumed by the option. NILIMWONA refers to seeing an animate person, not that beer.

findings.source: Fanatic: Кажется, я в тебе ошибся, человек. Ты совсем не понимаешь истинные причины происходящего.
findings.currentTarget: Fanatic: Inaonekana nilikukosea, Binadamu. Huelewi kabisa sababu halisi za yanayotokea.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Fanatic: Inaonekana nilikosea kukuhusu, Binadamu. Huelewi kabisa sababu halisi za yanayotokea.
findings.objectiveReason: Russian says he misjudged the player, as shown by immediately complaining that the player fails to understand. nilikukosea says he wronged/offended the player; kukuhusu preserves the judgment.
